mechanism: Both drugs are nephrotoxic and hepatotoxic; gentamicin causes dose-dependent renal toxicity while pyrazinamide causes hepatotoxicity and can elevate uric acid levels, potentially compounding organ dysfunction.
action: Monitor renal function (serum creatinine, BUN) and hepatic function (transaminases, bilirubin) regularly; adjust gentamicin dosing based on renal function; assess baseline renal and hepatic status before concurrent use.
